_comment: Glass look for three.js r170 MeshPhysicalMaterial on cosgral.pl (#050505 bg). Single source of truth: phone viewer (main.js) + cube_web*.glb (export_web.py). side=double renders the far grooves through the glass (dimmed by farSideDim); env = PMREM studio (strip power, sheen panels); edgeGlow = emissive boost on bevel/rounded faces; toneMapping Neutral keeps #050505 exact. Soap-bubble sheen: iridescence* = KHR_materials_iridescence (in the GLB); iridescenceNoise (swirl frequency, film thickness varies min..max over the surface) and iridescenceEdgeBias (weaker face-on, full at grazing/edges) are viewer shader tweaks - a plain GLTFLoader uses the max thickness everywhere.
